When you acquire a card other than an ally or a blessing, stash it as a plunder card. If you fail a check to defeat a henchman, banish 1d6 plunder cards. 

When you move to the Sea Fort, you may put any of your plunder cards under this scenario card; they are no longer considered plunder cards.
